selected_concept.title: Clean Commercial Fashion Showcase
selected_concept.thesis: Keep the blue polka-dot top unmistakably clear while presenting the outfit as polished, wearable and commercially desirable.
risks: could feel generic if execution lacks distinction

message_hierarchy.hero_message_intent: The upper garment is the unmistakable visual hero.
supporting_message_intents: The full outfit feels polished and easy to wear.
proof_points: Neckline, pattern and garment silhouette remain clearly readable.
message_hierarchy.cta_intent: Encourage product consideration and affiliate click-through.
avoid_claims: Do not claim exact fiber composition.
Do not invent brand or performance claims.

forbidden_mutations: Do not add a shirt collar or lapel.
Do not change the blue polka-dot identity.
Do not remove confirmed companion items.
warnings: Execution details must be delegated to downstream directors.
